researchQualityNote: All three scouts hit the same friction: the shared WebSearch budget was exhausted before or shortly into their work, forcing reliance on WebFetch against known Bulbapedia/Serebii/PokemonDB URLs, with several other guide sites (IGN, Eurogamer, Polygon, Nintendo Life, Game8) returning 404/bot-block errors. Most findings are marked medium rather than high confidence for this reason even where corroborated. Treat this dossier as solid on structure/names but softer than usual on exact numeric/UI details — flagged explicitly below.

entryGate.note: Switch has no system-level achievement/trophy system. Scarlet has never released on any other platform.
entryGate.resolvedMode: genesis — no native list exists anywhere for any release of this game.

premise: The player attends Naranja Academy in the Paldea region and is sent on an open-ended 'Treasure Hunt' independent-study assignment by director Clavell, which unlocks three parallel storylines: Victory Road (8 Gym Leaders), Path of Legends (5 Titan Pokémon, with Arven), and Starfall Street (5 Team Star bases, with the mystery of leader 'Cassiopeia'). All three converge on a fourth chapter, The Way Home, descending into Area Zero to confront the true nature of the AI professor Sada and the source of Paldea's Paradox Pokémon.
characterCorrection: IMPORTANT: no character named 'Clive' exists in this game (this was in the original research brief and is confirmed wrong). The AI professor is named Sada in Scarlet (Turo in Violet); the academy director is Clavell. Do not use 'Clive' anywhere in trophy text.

victoryRoad.note: Order is entirely player-chosen; the game does not enforce one. Katy/Grusha are community-convention 'first/last' by level, not game-enforced.
eliteFour: Larry (Flying — same character as the Normal Gym Leader, a unique dual role)
victoryRoad.champion: Geeta (Top Champion), varied team including a Terastallized Glimmora.
victoryRoad.confidence: high on names/types; medium on exact order/UI tracking

titans.name: Great Tusk
titans.title: Quaking Earth Titan
titans.versionExclusive: SCARLET-EXCLUSIVE — the Violet equivalent is Iron Treads. Direct version-exclusive difference in a mandatory boss fight.

titans.name: Tatsugiri
titans.title: False Dragon Titan
titans.note: Rides a much larger Dondozo; Dondozo itself is not the Titan.

pathOfLegends.finale: A full-strength Pokémon battle against Arven (later revealed as Professor Sada's son) once all 5 Titans are defeated and enough Herba Mystica collected.
pathOfLegends.confidence: medium — titan list/names high confidence, exact locations/order medium

starfallStreet.versionExclusiveCorrection: NOT version-exclusive — all five bosses/bases are identical in Scarlet and Violet; only uniform cosmetics differ slightly.
starfallStreet.finale: Penny reveals herself as 'Cassiopeia,' the true leader of Team Star, and battles the player to announce the team's disbanding.

finalChapter.name: The Way Home
finalChapter.detail: Unlocked once all three paths are complete. The player and companions descend to Zero Lab at the bottom of Area Zero. A security lockdown disables all Poké Balls except the player's Koraidon. The AI professor Sada is revealed as a robot built on the real (deceased) professor's research; the player defeats the AI, then confronts and defeats the second, hostile wild Koraidon (the one that killed the real professor) in a final battle.
finalChapter.confirmed: This is base-game content — no DLC required.

campaignStructure.ending: Single fixed ending ('Paradise Protection Protocol' — the AI shuts itself down via time travel). No branching found.
campaignStructure.confidence: high on overall structure; medium on some specific character/plot framing details (single-source, not independently cross-checked)

pokedex.conflict: Base-game Paldea Pokédex catchable total is DISPUTED across sources: Bulbapedia states 400 numbered entries; PokemonDB's breakdown (140 new + 233 returning) sums to 373. Could not resolve which is the true pre-DLC catchable count.
pokedex.percentageDisplayUnconfirmed: Could not confirm whether the Pokédex app displays an explicit completion PERCENTAGE (a series convention since Sun/Moon) — every source checked either paywalled, 404'd, or didn't address it directly for Scarlet/Violet specifically. Per-species Seen/Owned tracking IS confirmed to exist regardless.
pokedex.shinyCharmReward: Given by Jacq at Naranja Academy after registering all Pokémon (excluding Mythicals) as caught. Unconfirmed whether the box legendary itself counts or must be traded from a Violet copy.

academyAceTournament.detail: Post-game repeatable tournament, unlocked after completing all three main storylines. First run is a fixed bracket (Arven, Jacq, Dendra, then Champion Geeta); repeatable afterward with randomized opponents. Required to unlock 6-star/7-star Tera Raid Battles.
academyAceTournament.trackable: Confirmed NOT missable — repeatable indefinitely via an NPC at the academy front desk.

areaZero.detail: Accessed via Zero Gate. Contains Zero Lab (bottom, site of the time machine), four Research Stations, and multiple biome/crater zones with exclusive wild Paradox Pokémon.
areaZero.trackable: No explicit area-completion tracker found; Pokédex registration of exclusive Paradox species is the closest proxy.

sandwichSystem.detail: Recipe Mode (4 tiers, Master requires Herba Mystica) and Creative Mode. Up to 3 simultaneous 'Meal Powers' for 30 minutes (Encounter/Egg/Catching/Exp/Item Drop/Raid/Humungo-Teensy/Sparkling Power).
sandwichSystem.trackable: Number of distinct recipes made IS displayed in the player's Profile app — a clean, confirmed numeric tracker. 151 total pre-made recipes cited by Bulbapedia, though unconfirmed whether that's base-game-only or includes DLC recipes.

sideContent.tmCrafting: TM Machines at Pokémon Centers; League Points + TM Materials. Not confirmed whether a running total of TMs crafted is displayed anywhere.
sideContent.letsGoAutoBattle: Auto-battle system; never triggers against Shiny or Terastallized wild Pokémon; cannot faint the player's Pokémon; grants EXP and TM materials but no PP loss/EVs.
sideContent.teraRaidBattles: 1-star to 7-star raids, escalating IVs/HP. 5-star unlocks post-Academy Ace Tournament. Many 7-star raids were real-world time-limited post-launch events — treat any specific raid boss as likely already-expired, real-world-time-gated content, NOT suitable for a durable trophy.

dlc.name: The Hidden Treasure of Area Zero

parts.name: The Teal Mask
parts.scope: Kitakami region (school trip). Legendary Ogerpon (4 mask forms) and antagonists 'The Loyal Three' (Okidogi, Munkidori, Fezandipiti). New species: Dipplin, Poltchageist, Sinistcha, Bloodmoon Ursaluna. Side content: Perrin's photography sidequests, 'Ogre Oustin' minigame.

parts.name: The Indigo Disk
parts.scope: Blueberry Academy in a Terarium (Unova). BB League: 4 Elite Trial members (Lacey, Crispin, Amarys, Drayton) then Champion Kieran. New evolutions Archaludon/Hydrapple. Legendary Terapagos caught in Area Zero Underdepths — CONFIRMED DLC-EXCLUSIVE, not base-game postgame content (corrects a common assumption).

dlc.versionParity: Confirmed identical release dates and content structure for Scarlet and Violet; no DLC-internal version exclusivity found beyond the ongoing ancient/future Paradox split.
dlc.flagForCheckpoint: This is substantial, confirmed paid content, matching the precedent of building a separate DLC list (as done for Hyrule Warriors, Breath of the Wild, and Pokémon Legends Z-A earlier in this project).

systems.leaguePoints: In-game currency (LP), separate from Poké Dollars, used to craft TMs and buy some shop items. Persistent balance shown in Bag/shop menus.
systems.battlePointsCorrection: No 'Battle Points'/Battle Tower-style facility found in Scarlet/Violet — this term from a prior assumption does not apply to this game.
systems.koraidonForms: Koraidon starts in a weakened 'Limited Build' and progressively unlocks Sprinting/Swimming/Gliding Build via story-milestone sandwiches with Herba Mystica, culminating in the full battle-ready 'Apex Build' after the main story's climax. Each Build unlock is a discrete, noticeable story beat.
systems.shinyOdds: Base 1/4096. Shiny Charm (Pokédex completion reward) adds 2 rolls (~1/1365.7). Masuda Method (cross-language breeding) and Sparkling Power (sandwich buff, needs 2+ Herba Mystica) both stack further.
systems.teraTypeRandomization: Most wild Pokémon Tera Types match a normal type; 68 fixed 'wild Tera Pokémon' spawns have a pre-set differing Tera Type (not re-randomized).
systems.noDifficultyModes: No selectable difficulty mode found (consistent with mainline Pokémon convention); the open 3-path structure allows de facto sequence-breaking into harder areas early.
systems.multiplayerCaution: Union Circle (up to 4 players) is optional for almost everything, with ONE exception: Finizen only evolves into Palafin at level 38 while connected to another player. This is the one Pokédex-relevant mechanic depending on multiplayer — flagged as a real risk for any 'complete the Pokédex' trophy design (Rule 13).

versionExclusives.legendary: Koraidon (Fighting/Dragon, 'primeval' theme) is Scarlet's box legendary and permanent story mount; Miraidon is Violet's ('mechanical' theme). Obtaining the other version's legendary requires trading.
versionExclusives.dlcEraParadoxNote: Walking Wake (Teal Mask) and Gouging Fire/Raging Bolt (Indigo Disk) continue the Scarlet/ancient side; Iron Leaves (Teal Mask) and Iron Boulder/Iron Crown (Indigo Disk) continue Violet/future. These are DLC-era 2023 additions, not part of the Nov 2022 base release.
versionExclusives.academyName: Naranja Academy (Scarlet) vs. Uva Academy (Violet) — cosmetic only, same story role.
versionExclusives.otherWildExclusivesUnconfirmed: A reported list of ordinary (non-Paradox) version-exclusive wild encounters (Scarlet: Larvitar, Deino, Skrelp, Oranguru) came from a single, weakly-sourced summary and could not be independently cross-verified — treat as low confidence, avoid building a trophy around this specific list without further checking.
versionExclusives.charcadetCorrection: Charcadet's evolution into Armarouge/Ceruledge is an item choice (Auspicious/Malicious Armor), NOT version-locked — both items obtainable in both versions.

missables.name: Elite Four/Champion gauntlet is reportedly a single-attempt sequence in the main story push (per Serebii); rematches likely available later via Academy Ace Tournament, not independently confirmed.

Mystery Gift promotional distributions (numerous real-world time-limited codes over Scarlet/Violet's lifecycle) — most or all almost certainly expired as of today; treat any Mystery Gift-based trophy as inappropriate for a durable list.
Many 7-star Tera Raid event bosses were real-world time-limited post-launch events, largely expired now — same caution as Mystery Gift content.

conflicts.resolution: Unresolved — needs a primary check or should be avoided in trophy text as a specific number.

conflicts.finding: Expected by series convention (confirmed in Sun/Moon) but not specifically confirmed for Scarlet/Violet by either scout despite real effort.

scopeDecisionsResolved: DLC: The Hidden Treasure of Area Zero (Teal Mask + Indigo Disk) WILL get its own separate trophy list under `dlc` (Rule 14), never affecting the base Platinum.

Pokédex completion WILL get a Gold trophy, but trophy text will NOT cite a specific catchable total (400 vs 373 is unresolved) — verification will reference the Pokédex app's registration state generically.

Mystery Gift-based and expired Tera Raid event-boss content is EXCLUDED entirely from both the base and DLC lists — not missable-flagged, just left out, since these real-world time-gated distributions are almost certainly closed.

Exact base-game Pokédex catchable total unresolved (400 vs 373).
